purpose: Curated creative briefs for generating materially distinct, playable fantasy one-shots.
usage: Select one seed, then combine it with orthogonal tone, pressure, relationship, and location details at runtime.
selection_rules: Do not reuse a seed for the same player until the catalog has been exhausted.
Do not combine seeds that share the same core mechanic or emotional stake.
Keep the seed's impossible_rule central to the objective, locations, secrets, and choices.
Every generated adventure must expose at least three materially different approaches: social, investigative, and risky/physical.
Avoid default fantasy nouns and plots unless the seed makes them necessary.

seeds.setting: A saltworks town where every debt is written on a person's skin overnight.
seeds.impossible_rule: A debt disappears only when the creditor publicly admits what they wanted emotionally, not financially.
seeds.pressure: The protagonist's name appears on the ledger at sunset, owed by someone who died years ago.
seeds.human_stake: A dockworker will be exiled unless the town learns who profited from the old debt.
playable_levers: destroy or protect the salt archive

seeds.setting: A funeral procession crossing a city whose streetlamps cast shadows belonging to strangers.
seeds.impossible_rule: A shadow can testify, but it cannot lie about the person it currently follows.
seeds.pressure: The dead person's shadow walks away from the coffin toward the protagonist.
seeds.human_stake: The family will condemn an innocent mourner unless the shadow's testimony is understood.
playable_levers: follow the shadow into a litless district

seeds.setting: A harbor that experiences the same three minutes in different decades on each pier.
seeds.impossible_rule: Objects carried between piers keep the age they had where they were found.
seeds.pressure: A rescue bell rings from a ship that sank forty years ago, but someone answers it now.
seeds.human_stake: Saving one sailor may erase the life of the person who currently remembers them.
playable_levers: choose which version of the ship to save

seeds.setting: A courthouse where testimony becomes physically true when recorded by the clerk.
seeds.impossible_rule: The blank page records the most important fact that every speaker is avoiding.
seeds.pressure: The clerk has vanished, leaving one blank page and a verdict due before midnight.
seeds.human_stake: A village child will be sentenced for a crime that the adults collectively caused.
playable_levers: make the accused speak an avoided truth
alter who is recognized as a witness

seeds.setting: A valley apiary where bees pollinate memories instead of flowers.
seeds.impossible_rule: A memory harvested by a bee can be shared, but loses one sensory detail each time.
seeds.pressure: The last hive is carrying the memory of a disaster that the valley's leaders erased.
seeds.human_stake: The beekeeper's daughter will lose her mother's face unless the hive is moved before dawn.
playable_levers: protect the hive from competing keepers

seeds.setting: An abandoned theatre where each actor performs for the audience they most fear.
seeds.impossible_rule: The final scene changes according to who is watching, not who is acting.
seeds.pressure: The protagonist is cast without consent and the curtain rises on their private betrayal.
seeds.human_stake: A troupe will be trapped in rehearsal forever unless someone refuses the role written for them.
playable_levers: convince an actor to break character

seeds.setting: A river ferry whose tickets are receipts for favors owed in the future.
seeds.impossible_rule: The ferryman can cross any distance, but only toward a place where the passenger has broken a promise.
seeds.pressure: The next ticket bears the protagonist's handwriting and a promise they do not remember making.
seeds.human_stake: A refugee group must reach safety, but the crossing will expose one person's betrayal.
playable_levers: walk the riverbank and bypass the ferry

seeds.setting: A museum displaying mistakes that later became the foundations of great inventions.
seeds.impossible_rule: Removing an exhibit makes the original mistake happen again somewhere nearby.
seeds.pressure: A curator asks the protagonist to steal one exhibit before its owner comes to reclaim it.
seeds.human_stake: A young inventor's only failure is the key to saving a district from a preventable collapse.
playable_levers: learn from the failure instead of stealing it
let the mistake recur in a controlled place

seeds.setting: A dry village well containing a pocket of winter in the middle of summer.
seeds.impossible_rule: The cold preserves whatever truth is spoken inside it, but freezes the speaker's next decision.
seeds.pressure: The village's water source is warming, and the only replacement is guarded by a frozen confession.
seeds.human_stake: Two siblings must choose which version of their shared childhood the village will believe.
playable_levers: carry the winter to another source
break the preservation before the truth is complete

seeds.setting: A road that redraws its destination whenever someone says its name.
seeds.impossible_rule: The road only stops moving when travelers describe where they are, not where they want to go.
seeds.pressure: A cartographer has been walking for years and now maps the protagonist's home as the next destination.
seeds.human_stake: The cartographer's partner is waiting at a place that may no longer exist.
playable_levers: follow a map made from memories
choose whether to reveal the home's name

seeds.setting: A mountain choir whose missing singers still alter the weather when remembered.
seeds.impossible_rule: A song can summon a person only if every singer contributes a line they are ashamed of.
seeds.pressure: A storm is assembling above the pass because one missing singer refuses to be remembered honestly.
seeds.human_stake: Travelers stranded on both sides of the pass will freeze unless the choir stops protecting its founder.

seeds.setting: A bridge where a monster charges travelers for stories it has never heard.
seeds.impossible_rule: The toll is waived only when the story changes the teller's next action.
seeds.pressure: The monster is being evicted by a guild that needs the bridge's tolls to maintain the road.
seeds.human_stake: The monster's adopted child will lose both homes if the bridge is declared unsafe.
playable_levers: tell a story that changes a plan
relocate the bridge without moving it

seeds.setting: A town where red threads appear between people whenever they are about to make the same mistake.
seeds.impossible_rule: Cutting a thread prevents the mistake but transfers its consequence to the cutter.
seeds.pressure: A thread connects the protagonist to the town's beloved mayor, whose mistake is already underway.
seeds.human_stake: Stopping the mayor may save the town but expose a secret that will split it.
playable_levers: trace who first tied the thread
let the mistake happen in a smaller form

seeds.setting: An orchard bearing fruit that tastes like another person's most defining choice.
seeds.impossible_rule: Eating a fruit grants insight but causes one of the eater's own choices to be forgotten.
seeds.pressure: The orchard keeper offers the protagonist a fruit grown from their own future.
seeds.human_stake: A village council will exile a teenager based on a choice they have not yet made.
playable_levers: protect the teenager from predictive justice

seeds.setting: A manor whose rooms rearrange themselves to keep servants and nobles from meeting.
seeds.impossible_rule: A room opens only when someone inside gives up a privilege they could have kept.
seeds.pressure: The kitchen and nursery have been sealed apart during a dangerous household uprising.
seeds.human_stake: The servants need a child heir's testimony, while the heir needs the servants' protection.
playable_levers: force a meeting in the room that should not exist

seeds.setting: A city where dragons are protected only while their paperwork remains current.
seeds.impossible_rule: A legal name changes the physical shape of the creature that bears it.
seeds.pressure: The last dragon's renewal form lists a human witness who has been dead for a century.
seeds.human_stake: The dragon will be dismantled for parts unless someone proves its identity without its original witness.
playable_levers: audit the city's old naming records
find a living relationship that qualifies as witness
help the dragon choose a new shape

seeds.setting: A lakeside village lights lanterns for children who have not yet been born.
seeds.impossible_rule: A lantern goes dark when its future child is no longer possible, but nobody knows why.
seeds.pressure: The protagonist's lantern is lit beside a second one bearing the name of a stranger.
seeds.human_stake: The village wants to sacrifice a current child to restore the lost futures.
playable_levers: challenge the village's definition of possibility

seeds.setting: A market where people pay for goods with hours of sleep and dream collectors keep the accounts.
seeds.impossible_rule: A stolen dream becomes a real place until its owner wakes from it.
seeds.pressure: A child's stolen nightmare has become a district where adults are disappearing.
seeds.human_stake: The collectors will erase the child’s memory to close the account.
playable_levers: help the child change the nightmare from within

seeds.setting: A farm whose fields migrate at night, leaving crops in places that never had soil.
seeds.impossible_rule: The land follows the person who most needs to leave it.
seeds.pressure: The farm has moved under the city prison, and its owner refuses to explain why.
seeds.human_stake: A harvest can feed the city, but only if the imprisoned person is released.
playable_levers: convince the owner to name the person

seeds.setting: A bell tower broadcasting tomorrow's news, but only in the voice of someone currently missing.
seeds.impossible_rule: The broadcast changes when listeners collectively choose not to repeat it.
seeds.pressure: Tomorrow's message announces a revolution that will begin with the protagonist's arrest.
seeds.human_stake: The resistance needs the broadcast, but repeating it makes its worst prediction inevitable.
playable_levers: spread the meaning without the words
stage an arrest that breaks the prediction

seeds.setting: A tailor's shop stitching borders between countries into coats and curtains.
seeds.impossible_rule: A sewn border can be crossed only by someone who carries a contradiction about home.
seeds.pressure: The tailor has stitched two hostile borders together and both armies are approaching.
seeds.human_stake: A family separated by the border can reunite only if the stitched line is not cut.
playable_levers: find a person who embodies the contradiction
redesign the border as a shared route
protect the tailor from both governments

seeds.setting: An observatory where two skies overlap and each predicts a different disaster.
seeds.impossible_rule: The telescope shows the disaster a viewer is most willing to prevent, not the most likely one.
seeds.pressure: The astronomer asks the protagonist to destroy one lens before both predictions become true.
seeds.human_stake: Choosing one sky saves a city but abandons a smaller community erased from official maps.
playable_levers: test what the telescope responds to

seeds.setting: A tenement where ghosts remain only while someone living remembers their unpaid rent.
seeds.impossible_rule: A ghost can alter one household object each night, but only to solve a problem they had in life.
seeds.pressure: The building manager plans to evict the ghosts by forgiving every debt at once.
seeds.human_stake: Living tenants depend on the ghosts' interventions, but one ghost is endangering a family.

seeds.setting: A village where every public decision is voted on during a shared dream.
seeds.impossible_rule: The dream counts a vote only when the voter admits what they would lose.
seeds.pressure: The next dream will decide whether to abandon the village before a landslide, but nobody can wake early.
seeds.human_stake: A minority family's land is the only safe route out.
playable_levers: change the route rather than the vote
make the majority experience the minority's loss

seeds.setting: A clockmaker's district where one clock removes an hour from anyone who refuses forgiveness.
seeds.impossible_rule: The missing hour returns only when forgiveness is specific and costs the forgiver something.
seeds.pressure: The clock has taken the same hour from everyone, including the person who built it.
seeds.human_stake: A feud is keeping the district's apprentices trapped in a repeating workday.
playable_levers: repair the mechanism without repairing the feud
decide whether forgiveness should be compulsory

seeds.setting: A palace staircase descends into a kingdom built from everything the court has discarded.
seeds.impossible_rule: Discarded objects remember the reasons their owners abandoned them.
seeds.pressure: The discarded kingdom's ruler offers the protagonist a crown made from their own lost belongings.
seeds.human_stake: The palace will collapse if the hidden kingdom returns what the court refuses to acknowledge.

seeds.setting: A forest where a wolf carries the name of the village and is hunted whenever the village panics.
seeds.impossible_rule: Renaming the wolf changes one law of the village, chosen by whoever speaks first.
seeds.pressure: The wolf has started speaking in the voice of a missing mayor.
seeds.human_stake: Killing it may restore order but erase the only witness to the mayor's disappearance.
playable_levers: change the village law through consent

seeds.setting: A library cataloguing inventions, relationships, and wars that were almost created.
seeds.impossible_rule: Reading an unmade thing makes it possible but gives it one reader's regret as its motive.
seeds.pressure: A librarian wants to release an unmade bridge to rescue a town, knowing it will be built from an old betrayal.
seeds.human_stake: The rescue requires choosing which regret will become part of the town's future.
playable_levers: find the least harmful unmade bridge
save people without making the bridge real

seeds.setting: A feast where each dish satisfies the hunger of the person who cooked it, not the person who eats it.
seeds.impossible_rule: The table reveals a secret when someone refuses a dish offered for their benefit.
seeds.pressure: The host has prepared a meal that could end a war, but every guest must refuse something first.
seeds.human_stake: A captive negotiator will die if the guests keep treating sacrifice as virtue.
playable_levers: identify whose hunger each dish carries
refuse publicly and name the cost
change the feast's seating and alliances

seeds.setting: A city where rain falls as ink containing memories of places upstream.
seeds.impossible_rule: Reading the rain preserves a memory but makes the reader responsible for its unfinished action.
seeds.pressure: A black storm carries the memory of a dam about to break in a forgotten settlement.
seeds.human_stake: The city can divert the flood only by admitting it benefited from the settlement's erasure.
playable_levers: redirect the storm at a political cost

seeds.setting: A village where every child inherits one monster from an ancestor at their thirteenth birthday.
seeds.impossible_rule: The monster becomes gentler when its heir sets a boundary it cannot cross.
seeds.pressure: The next heir inherits a monster the village insists was destroyed generations ago.
seeds.human_stake: The child must choose between exile, obedience, and teaching the monster a new role.

seeds.setting: A bridge that extends only when someone says goodbye to a place they are still trying to return to.
seeds.impossible_rule: A goodbye is accepted only if the speaker names what they will carry forward.
seeds.pressure: The bridge is one span short, and the far bank holds a city being evacuated.
seeds.human_stake: The protagonist must help a group cross while one member refuses to abandon a lost home.
playable_levers: build a temporary span from carried memories
